scope: Independent read-only source-faithfulness review of root-owned CoreModules.lean and CoreAnalysis.lean; no root proof/source files edited by this reviewer.
review_method: Read the theorem propositions and proof assumptions against current source questions/worked solutions. Distinguish universal optimization from a single substitution, all-natural-time results from finite simulations, and true measure/limit statements from algebraic implications. Previously reported attainment/KKT gaps were reread after root additions.
result: No contradiction with mapped source conclusions or hidden source-invalid assumptions identified in the reviewed propositions. Source/model identification and whole-exercise coverage remain limited by the root per-subclaim ledger.

resolved_findings.original_observation: barrier_p3_optimal supplied a global objective lower bound but no explicit optimizer/correction witness; do not infer attainment solely from the inequality.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added barrier_p3_attained and barrier_p3_unique; current witness u=-1 is feasible, correction is 2, and objective is 2.

resolved_findings.original_observation: barrier_p5_optimal and barrier_p5_unique proved a lower bound and conditional uniqueness, but omitted feasible attainment and the requested multiplier.
resolved_findings.resolution: Root added barrier_p5_attained_kkt; current witness u=v=mu=1/2 satisfies feasibility, objective 1/4, dual feasibility, stationarity expression and complementary slackness.

important_faithfulness_checks: discounted_constant proves an actual infinite series under |gamma|<1; its MDP application additionally has gamma in [0,1).
Dual upper bounds require multiplier nonnegativity; exact dual minimum and attainment are separate source-specific statements.
CVaR examples use piecewise objectives and global all-threshold minima, rather than identifying CVaR from only a selected threshold.
Robust barrier control and held-input intervals quantify every disturbance/time in the stated set.
Lyapunov strict decrease excludes the equilibrium explicitly; geometric convergence requires q>=0 and q<1.

CoreAnalysis.nonlinear_envelope and nonlinear_convergence use the actual nonlinear recurrence and initial squared-state bound; they do not assume a nonexistent uniform contraction factor on the full interval.
Validation minimality is exact for every natural n using rational powers; the single-policy and twenty-policy thresholds remain distinct.
Finite union/composition bounds use actual measures and do not add independence assumptions.
Sampled lower/upper certificate theorems assume a proved Lipschitz bound plus explicit sample value and geometric distance; they do not infer global validity from finite sampling alone.
affine_error_bound retains the complete finite geometric sum and the initial-zero premise; a linear-in-time shortcut for arbitrary L is not substituted.
Rounded-LMI rejection is a genuine negative rational quadratic-form witness; floating-point appearance is not treated as PSD proof.
limits: Lean compilation is handled by root and is separate from this semantic peer review.
The review does not claim every root original exercise or every model/trajectory interpretation is formally encoded.
The exact current per-file hashes identify the reviewed snapshot.
